get_lr_at_epoch: get the learning rate for a given epoch with warmup support using the configured LR policy
lr_func_cosine: compute the cosine annealing learning rate schedule for a given epoch based on config values
lr_func_steps_with_relative_lrs: compute the step-based learning rate with relative multipliers for a given epoch
get_step_index: retrieve the learning rate step index for a given epoch from the configured step boundaries
get_lr_func: retrieve the named learning rate policy function by its string policy name
